challenges.attack: TOCTOU symlink race on synthetic root manifest read
challenges.expected_behavior: Manifest opens descriptor-relatively with no symlink follow.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Replace manifest with symlink between independent path checks and read.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair Path.is_symlink plus Path.read_bytes used independent resolutions.

challenges.attack: Generic path parser can traverse intermediate symlinks
challenges.expected_behavior: Accounting artifacts use retained-root descriptor-relative reads.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Replace intermediate parent before generic read_artifact(path).
challenges.observed_behavior: Generic read_artifact uses O_NOFOLLOW on the leaf; accounting-root reads use read_artifact_at on the retained descriptor.

challenges.attack: In-place journal truncation combined with deleted starts may produce false zero
challenges.expected_behavior: Previously latched starts remain one and journal truncation is corrupt authority.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: ftruncate retained journal and unlink all durable-start artifacts after verified starts.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair in-process start latch already preserved one, but an empty truncated journal was mislabeled OBSERVED_PRESENT.

challenges.attack: Lower bound may decrease after journal truncation
challenges.expected_behavior: Lower bounds are explicitly monotonic across repeated observations.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Observe starts, truncate journal, remove start artifacts, and observe twice.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair start latch was monotonic but no separately named lower-bound latch existed.

challenges.expected_behavior: Reject oversized float token before float conversion.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: One float token with up to one million fractional digits.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair json.loads had parse_int but no parse_float hook.

challenges.attack: sys.modules and builtins dynamic resolution bypass direct-parser AST policy
challenges.expected_behavior: Reject module registries and dynamic resolution primitives.
challenges.observed_behavior: Pre-repair policy did not inspect sys.modules.

challenges.attack: Hardlink may import original checkpoint inode into synthetic root
challenges.expected_behavior: Synthetic shards require st_nlink exactly one.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: Replace a synthetic shard with a hardlink to an external inode containing identical bytes.
challenges.observed_behavior: The committed source already calls _hash_descriptor(... require_single_link=True); direct external-inode regression was not separately indexed.
